reading_rule: All suffixes carry SI units except explicitly named days, years, degrees and g/m2. Hardware variants are alternatives; never add their masses. Local cases stop physical claims at contact. Service counts conditional on fault containment and finite transit; their independent flat-lattice optical fractions are not total shield transmission.

fleet_service.interpretation: Uniform independent failure optical comparison only, baseline seams/holes excluded. Correlated-case optical estimates are withheld. Every queue assumes failed hardware is contained; local fault response must establish that separately.
fleet_service.rate_evidence: 0.001, 0.01 and 0.1 failures per tile-year are sensitivities, not measured reliability; 15-year renewal is an assumed policy.

industry_comparison.interpretation: Counterfactual hardware mass at the old population and class share. Not a re-flown shield or a film-only factory load. Whole-tile exchange is a conservative service policy; component reuse and manufacturing processes are not designed.
